notes.title: Folian paid beta release candidate
items: Uses config.folian.app for desktop update discovery and the remote AI model catalogue.
Adds verified current and older supported AI model choices.
Keeps the stable desktop channel inactive until a real stable release is promoted.
Protects partial project setting updates from clearing omitted fields.
Preserves local projects, encrypted API keys, exports and backups during application updates.

notes.title: Folian beta foundation
items: Structured project setup, manuscript editing, research and export workflows.
